title: Tom Brady couldn’t resist dig at ‘cranky’ Bill Belichick during Georgetown commencement speech

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tom Brady couldn’t resist dig at ‘cranky’ Bill Belichick during Georgetown commencement speech
sources.description: The seven-time Super Bowl champ and three-time MVP had the mic at Georgetown University's business school graduation and largely spoke about facing and conquering adversity.
